title: Latent-to-Latent Flow for Volumetric Stochastic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Uncertainty arising from inter-observer variability in medical image segmentation plays an important role in developing treatment plans. Research in this area is inhibited by the lack of multiple annotations for large-scale medical datasets, especially for volumetric data, which suffers from additional scaling and computational complexity challenges. Flow matching has emerged as a powerful framework for generative modelling and has also been demonstrated to maintain strong performance when working with latent representations of images. In this work, we introduce a latent-to-latent flow technique for stochastic segmentation of medical volumes via encoded representations of both the image and label space. translated_title: 面向体积随机分割的潜空间到潜空间流方法
translated_abstract: 医学图像分割中由观察者间差异引起的不确定性在制定治疗计划中起着重要作用。该领域的研究受到大规模医学数据集缺乏多重标注的阻碍，尤其是体积数据，还面临额外的缩放和计算复杂性挑战。流匹配已成为一种强大的生成建模框架，并且已被证明在处理图像的潜在表示时仍能保持强大的性能。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种潜空间到潜空间的流技术，通过对图像空间和标签空间进行编码表示，实现医学体积的随机分割。我们在两个具有挑战性的应用上评估了我们的方法，包括放射治疗计划中的勾画不确定性和多器官结构分割，与全分辨率模型相比，效率提升了高达14倍，同时保持了分割性能。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于潜空间到潜空间流匹配的医学体积随机分割方法，利用图像和标签空间的编码表示，在放射治疗勾画不确定性和多器官分割任务上实现了比全分辨率模型最高14倍的效率提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a latent-to-latent flow matching approach for stochastic segmentation of medical volumes via encoded representations of image and label spaces, achieving up to 14x efficiency improvement over full-resolution models on radiotherapy delineation uncertainty and multi-organ segmentation tasks.
